baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence كَفَرُوا ... مَاتُوا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ moves from a finite act to death and a circumstantial noun of continuing identity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering or repudiating truth begins as an act, joins active diversion from God's traversable way, and survives the loss-of-life boundary as an abiding condition. The emphatic future negation therefore attaches non-forgiveness to a trajectory that reaches death unreversed, not to mortality by itself.

activation_trace.role: Hiding or repudiating truth supplies the initial occlusion, while the repeated verb-to-noun form makes that occlusion persist as identity.
Turning away and turning others away supplies the active diversion that converts private refusal into route obstruction.
An extended traversable road or means makes the blocked object an access route rather than a bare proposition.
Loss of life and force supplies the irreversible boundary at which the still-present condition becomes terminal.
Covering a fault while shielding its bearer from consequence defines the reparative protection emphatically withheld after that boundary.

changed_reading.before: A categorical statement that disbelievers who die will not be pardoned.
changed_reading.after: A temporal mechanism in which truth-covering and route-blocking harden from acts into a condition carried through death, after which reparative protection is no longer opened.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction صَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ joins diversion or prevention to a path that is meant to be traversed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can hold both intransitive and transitive force: they turn away from the route and make others' passage harder. The barrier image intensifies this into an access-control reading, so the offense is not merely holding a false belief but converting an open means of approach into obstructed terrain.

activation_trace.role: The literal pair of withdrawal and prevention preserves both self-diversion and diversion of others in one mechanism.
A mountain-like obstruction supplies the spatial image of an imposed barrier across access.
A road extended for passage makes the social effect measurable as interrupted movement toward God.

changed_reading.before: They rejected religion and kept others from it.
changed_reading.after: They both abandon and obstruct a shared access route, turning a means intended for passage into a public barrier.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: K-F-R and Gh-F-R both activate covering, but the first names the subjects' occlusion and the second names God's protective treatment of fault.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse stages asymmetrical coverings. The subjects maintain a cover that hides truth and blocks its route; the promised negation withholds the unlike cover that would conceal fault while preserving the person from its effect. The result is not a simple word equivalence but a reversal between self-sealing concealment and restorative shelter.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the subjects' occlusive layer and makes their repeated state one of maintained concealment.
Covering the truth specifies what the subjects' layer hides and prevents the material analogy from becoming neutral.
A cover that also preserves supplies the contrasting shelter denied by the future negation.
Shielding a sinner from the effect of fault gives the second covering its specifically reparative function.

changed_reading.before: God simply refuses to erase their sins.
changed_reading.after: Their truth-obscuring cover is carried to death, and the unlike divine cover that would shelter them from its consequences is then emphatically unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah repeats the focus's obstruction formula and immediately makes intentional works become lost. This turns route-blocking into reciprocal teleology: agents who prevent passage toward an end also produce works that fail to reach their own end, a pattern repeated as work-collapse elsewhere before 47:34.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and prevention anchor the focus action whose consequence the opening supplies.
The same literal diversion repeats the focus mechanism and makes the opening consequence directly comparable.
Literal loss makes obstruction rebound as works that no longer arrive at a preserving destination.
Purposeful action supplies the affected output, so what is lost is intended efficacy rather than mere motion.

structural_cues: 47:1 opens with the same kufr-sadd-sabil chain as 47:34 and immediately predicates loss of works.
47:8, 47:9, 47:28, and 47:32 repeatedly return to works being lost or collapsed before the focus verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated obstruction and repeated work-loss; I supply the reciprocal arrow that blocking a route makes the blockers' own purposeful action lose destination. The live alternative is simple juxtaposition of offense and penalty.

changed_reading.before: Non-forgiveness is an isolated penalty added at death.
changed_reading.after: Non-forgiveness is the terminal expression of a process already visible as purposeful works losing destination when their agents obstruct destination-bearing paths.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 47:2 the same K-F-R root names God's covering-away of believers' wrongs and is followed by repair of their condition. Against that constructive use, the focus's repeated K-F-R cannot be reduced to neutral covering: it is the culpable cover that rejects truth and blocks passage, while divine covering remains a reparative possibility in the contrasting trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Truth-obscuring denial fixes the negative value of the focus's repeated covering.
Protective covering of fault supplies the reparative act that the focus denies only to the terminal cohort.
Making offenses as though unperformed reverses K-F-R into reparative erasure and exposes the focus's negative covering as a chosen mode, not the root's only value.
Restoration against corruption makes the constructive covering part of an actual repair sequence.
A repaired and eased condition supplies the inward result of that reparative covering.

structural_cues: 47:2 places causative K-F-R before repair of condition; 47:34 places repeated culpable K-F-R before emphatic denial of Gh-F-R.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root in opposed moral operations and a repair sequence; I infer a deliberate contrast between occlusive and reparative covering. Ordinary polysemy without a designed contrast remains possible.

changed_reading.before: K-F-R marks one fixed negative category and Gh-F-R is an unrelated pardon term.
changed_reading.after: The surah differentiates a truth-blocking cover from a God-given cover that removes fault and repairs condition; the focus closes the second only after the first persists to death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The 47:4-5 sequence places another death beside the same path but promises that the slain person's works will not be lost, then promises guidance and repair. Biological death is therefore not the operative cause in 47:34; the decisive feature is arriving at death while still inhabiting truth-covering obstruction rather than path-directed fidelity.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the common boundary whose differing outcomes require another explanatory variable.
Persisting truth-denial supplies that variable through the circumstantial state at death.
Actual loss of life supplies the contrasting death whose aftermath is preserving rather than nullifying.
The traversable way places the contrasting dead within the very route that the focus cohort obstructs.
Literal loss is negated for their works, reversing the work-loss attached to obstruction.
Gentle direction toward the road supplies continued post-death orientation rather than terminal route-loss.
Repair against corruption supplies the preserving sequel denied to the focus cohort.

structural_cues: 47:4-6 forms a death-to-preserved-work-to-guidance-to-repair sequence for those killed in God's path.
47:34 instead makes the manner or continuing state at death explicit with وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two deaths with opposed route relations and outcomes; I infer that terminal orientation, not death itself, controls the contrast. The alternative is that the cohorts are contrasted without making a general causal claim.

changed_reading.before: Death closes forgiveness simply because no later action is possible.
changed_reading.after: Death is a diagnostic boundary: works and repair continue across it for path-directed persons, while truth-covering obstruction carried through it becomes terminal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's explicit contrast between God as the believers' mawla and the disbelievers' lack of a mawla adds a relational layer to لَهُمْ in the focus. Forgiveness can be heard not only as cancellation in a ledger but as the protective act of a near patron; dying in maintained opposition leaves no such patronal shelter operative for them.

activation_trace.role: Shielding the fault-bearer from consequence supplies the protective action needing a relationship.
Near alliance, love, and support supply the patronal relation present for one cohort and explicitly absent for the other.

structural_cues: 47:11 balances God as mawla of believers against no mawla for disbelievers in one antithetical sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective forgiveness and contrasted patronage; I infer that the latter colors the former as relational shelter. A strictly juridical reading of forgiveness remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: God declines a legal pardon for them.
changed_reading.after: The terminal obstruction also leaves them outside the near protective patronage through which pardon would shelter its recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 47:15 forgiveness is coordinated with a covered garden, flowing rivers, and fruit, and at 47:19 it remains an act to seek for a living believing community. This spatializes protective covering as part of a habitable provision. The focus's non-forgiveness can therefore imply terminal exclusion from restorative shelter and flow, not an absence of divine capacity to forgive.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover anchors forgiveness as shelter rather than bare deletion.
A garden covered by growth supplies the inhabitable enclosure in which forgiveness is listed as provision.
Channels cutting earth with flowing water supply sustained circulation inside that protected habitat.
Fault-covering protection appears within the garden inventory and joins moral repair to habitable provision.
The commanded seeking of protective pardon shows that this cover is active before the focus's terminal boundary.
Fault or sin supplies the concrete object for which protective covering is sought.
Heart-security and trust supply the living community enclosed by the request for forgiveness.

structural_cues: 47:15 coordinates forgiveness with garden provisions before contrasting enduring fire and scalding water.
47:19 commands seeking forgiveness for a living community, so 47:34's negation is cohort- and endpoint-specific.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-location of forgiveness, covered garden, flow, and communal petition; I infer a habitat metaphor linking them. The legal sense of forgiveness does not depend on that metaphor and remains coexisting.

changed_reading.before: No forgiveness means only that a debt remains uncancelled.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean that persistent blockers reach death outside the restorative cover, flow, and communal shelter in which forgiveness otherwise operates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from listening without retained understanding to stamped hearts and then asks whether locks sit upon hearts. This gives the focus's external route obstruction an inward architecture: a person blocks the path socially while a sealed and locked center blocks the movement of recitation into comprehension and obedience.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and prevention provide the outer blockage that the context internalizes.
A route meant for passage lets inward comprehension be modeled as movement that can be stopped.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the passage that fails despite audible listening.
A stamped seal supplies the closure that prevents heard material from becoming inwardly operative.
The heart as inward center locates the sealed endpoint of the failed passage.
Considering an affair through its outcome supplies the reflective movement that the locked-heart question says is absent.
Literal closure, hardness, and dryness supply the inner barrier corresponding to the focus's blocked road.

structural_cues: 47:16 stages listening followed by failure to retain what was said.
47:24 directly opposes reflective reading to locks upon hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer obstruction, failed understanding, seals, and locks; I infer a feedback loop in which social blocking and inner closure reinforce each other. The alternative keeps the outer and inner descriptions as parallel but causally unlinked.

changed_reading.before: They externally stop people from following God's path.
changed_reading.after: Their public obstruction coexists with an internal blocked route: sound reaches them, but sealed and locked inward access prevents it becoming reflective obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The retreat of 47:25 occurs after guidance has become clear, is made attractive, and is granted an extended interval. That sequence fills the focus's ثُمَّ with a live history: the terminal condition need not be primordial ignorance but can be a prolonged, psychologically sustained reversal after disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Repudiating known truth supplies the condition that the reversal narrative can explain diachronically.
Loss of life supplies the endpoint after the context's extended interval.
Religious retreat supplies an actual reversal rather than a static starting identity.
Turning the back supplies the directional movement away from previously approached guidance.
Disclosure and emergence make the reversal post-clarity rather than merely uninformed.
Gentle direction to the true road supplies the route that had already become available before retreat.
Psychological embellishment supplies the mechanism that makes backward movement feel sustainable.
Extension of time supplies duration between reversal and the focus's death boundary.
Respite and prolongation preserve the split root's second temporal image and sharpen persistence rather than instant collapse.

structural_cues: 47:25 orders retreat after clarified guidance, then embellishment, then prolongation.
47:34 orders kufr and obstruction, then death, then the continuing-state clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies post-clarity retreat, embellishment, and two convergent mapped images of prolonged time; I infer that this history can occupy the focus's temporal interval. A separate referent group or a shorter unexpressed interval remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The subjects are a static class whose state at death merely repeats their starting label.
changed_reading.after: Their terminal identity can be the result of a long post-clarity reversal, made attractive and extended until death closes the still-reversible interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence 47:26-31 moves from concealed allegiance to taking of souls, extraction of what was hidden, recognition by marks and inflected speech, and tests that disclose inner reports. The focus's وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ can therefore name a latent coherence that becomes diagnosable and finally exposed at death, while still allowing an overt public identity reading.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering anchors the possibility that the terminal condition was partly concealed before being exposed.
Hiding something inward supplies the concealed allegiance that precedes disclosure.
Taking the soul in full supplies the death event as a complete reckoning boundary rather than mere disappearance.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the transition from latent inward content to exposure.
A visible sign that indicates condition supplies one diagnostic surface for the hidden state.
A recognition mark preserves the split mapping's second diagnostic image and reinforces legibility.
The slant or implication of speech supplies an audible trace through which concealed orientation leaks.
Testing that makes condition appear supplies an active disclosure process before the terminal verdict.
Trial that reveals state preserves the second mapped inventory and confirms disclosure as the shared image.
Knowledge of report and inward reality supplies the content that testing renders inspectable.

structural_cues: 47:26 juxtaposes partial outward obedience with secrets known to God.
The branchless root ض غ ن at 47:29 names the concealed content brought out and is used here only as a structural cue.
47:30-31 moves from marks and speech-patterns to testing of reports immediately before the restated obstruction formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secrecy, full soul-taking, extraction, diagnostic marks, speech slant, tests, and inward report; I infer that the focus's terminal noun can summarize a latent pattern made manifest at the boundary. The alternative is a wholly overt identity that needs no discovery.

changed_reading.before: While disbelievers merely restates a publicly obvious label at death.
changed_reading.after: The clause can also certify the final disclosure of a concealed but coherent orientation that leaked through allegiance and speech, was tested into visibility, and remained at soul-taking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim 47:32 restatement inserts opposition to the messenger after guidance has become clear, denies any injury to God, and predicts collapse of works; 47:33 then warns believers not to nullify their works. These additions make the focus verdict the terminal edge of self-nullifying opposition, not compensation for harm done to God.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and prevention anchor the repeated formula whose mechanism the preceding ayah expands.
Protective pardon supplies the terminal preservation that follows the context's work-collapse sequence only as a negation.
A group split by conflict supplies opposition as social rupture rather than private uncertainty.
Striving for mastery in opposition preserves a non-dominant mapped image and adds active contest to the rupture.
Manifest clarification makes the opposition informed and removes simple obscurity as its sole explanation.
Gentle direction to the true route supplies what had become clear before opposition.
Descent and collapse supply the loss of effective standing assigned to their works.
Purposeful deeds supply the output that collapses while God remains unharmed.
Actively removing a thing supplies self-nullification as an avoidable process, not only an imposed result.
Purposeful works are again the threatened object, linking warning and verdict across the focus boundary.

structural_cues: 47:32 repeats 47:34's opening kufr-sadd-sabil wording and adds informed opposition, divine invulnerability, and work-collapse.
47:33 immediately converts work-nullification into a warning addressed to believers before 47:34 states the terminal case.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-verbatim expansion and an adjacent prohibition; I infer that work-nullification is the process whose terminal form includes non-forgiveness. The live alternative treats collapsed works and denied forgiveness as related but independent consequences.

changed_reading.before: God withholds forgiveness because the blockers have injured the divine cause.
changed_reading.after: Their informed opposition cannot injure God; it splits them from guidance and collapses their own purposeful work until death makes the loss of protective pardon terminal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ayat after the focus promise that faithful works will not be diminished, then close by calling for expenditure in God's path and diagnosing withholding as self-directed loss before replacement. This lets route-blocking coexist with an economic-circulatory reading: refusing outflow obstructs a shared channel, impoverishes the withholder, and does not impoverish God.

activation_trace.role: A barrier supplies the blockage image that the closing expenditure scene converts into interrupted circulation.
A traversable means supplies the shared channel through which persons and resources can move.
A deficit that strips right or work is explicitly negated, supplying the preserved-work side of the economy.
Wealth going outward supplies literal expenditure as circulation through the path.
A through-passage with an outlet supplies the material analogy of flow that obstruction can stop.
The same traversable way directly locates expenditure within the route blocked in the focus.
Miserly withholding supplies the concrete act that constricts the route's resource flow.
The self or very person identifies the withholder as the immediate bearer of the constriction's loss.
Self-sufficiency establishes that the blocked outflow creates no divine need or deficit.
Need and lack place the deficit on the human side of the obstructed exchange.
One party standing in another's place supplies replacement when a cohort refuses circulation.

structural_cues: 47:35 immediately follows the focus with a promise that works will not be diminished.
47:38 repeats God's path in a call to spend, repeats withholding three times, assigns its effect to the self, contrasts divine wealth with human need, and ends with replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-diminution, expenditure in the same path, withholding, self-loss, divine sufficiency, and replacement; I supply the circulation arrow joining them to route-blockage. The alternative keeps military-social obstruction and economic withholding as separate applications.

changed_reading.before: Blocking God's path harms a divine project and elicits retaliatory non-forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: Blocking can also be withholding from a channel that benefits its participants: the withholder constricts and impoverishes the self, God remains sufficient, and the obstructing cohort is replaceable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from juridical language into an agricultural material analogy and activates branch-distant images of farmer-covering, grain, and dead land. It remains anchored in four focus roots and is sharpened by the context's fruit and water. Downstream prose must mark it as an image overlay, never translate كَفَرُوا as sowing or سَبِيل as an ear of grain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes K-F-R covering, S-B-L, death, and denied Gh-F-R covering, allowing a contained failed-germination overlay.

activation_trace.role: A farmer's covering of seed supplies a normally generative cover whose function is reversed by obstructive truth-covering.
An extended grain ear supplies the latent growth image attached, by root only, to the focus's actual road word.
Unrevived, uncultivated dead land supplies the failed-growth endpoint of the analogy.
A preserving cover supplies the restorative shelter whose negation prevents the analogy from reaching renewal.
Ripe fruit supplies the context's realized-growth counterimage to the focus overlay's dead ground.
Water channels through earth supply the life-bearing flow absent from the obstructed, dead-ground image.

changed_reading.before: Covering is only concealment and death is only a legal cutoff.
changed_reading.after: As a carefully marked material overlay, a cover that should nurture seed is perverted into route-blocking concealment, ending in dead ground without the preserving cover and flow that would bring growth to fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the finite form مَاتُوا unambiguously carries physical death in the sentence, while a distant M-W-T branch can mean yielding to truth. The branch remains valuable as a counterfactual resonance, sharpened by obedience and retreat in context, but downstream prose must not substitute 'submitted' for 'died'; it may only say they met one kind of death without undergoing the other kind of yielding.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's death root sits immediately before the statement that truth-denial still characterizes them.

activation_trace.role: Actual loss of life fixes the sentence's grammatical event and contains the outlier.
Yielding to truth supplies the missed counterfactual carried beside, but not in place of, physical death.
Continued truth-denial proves that the counterfactual yielding did not occur before life ended.
Obedient yielding supplies the nearby positive posture against which the missed M-W-T resonance becomes legible.
Retreat from the faith supplies the contrary movement that persists toward physical death.

changed_reading.before: They physically died without changing category.
changed_reading.after: As contained root-play, they underwent the death that ends bodily force while refusing the other M-W-T possibility of yielding to truth, so the denial-state crosses the boundary intact.

strongest_changes: Death became a diagnostic terminal boundary rather than the cause of exclusion: 47:4-6 preserves and repairs another dead cohort whose relation to the path is opposite.
K-F-R and Gh-F-R became rival covering operations, sharpened by 47:2's reparative use of K-F-R and by forgiveness as active provision in 47:15 and 47:19.
The sequence from post-clarity retreat through secrecy, marks, speech, and testing made وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ readable as a latent condition disclosed and carried intact to soul-taking.
The near-verbatim 47:32 expansion and 47:33 warning tied obstruction to informed opposition and self-nullified works while explicitly denying harm to God.
The closing expenditure scene allowed path-blockage to coexist with withheld circulation: constriction impoverishes the withholder, not God, and permits replacement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses a whole trajectory into repeated K-F-R, one obstructed route, ثُمَّ, a death boundary, and an emphatic denial of Gh-F-R. Context repeatedly unpacks that compression through reversible covering, lost or preserved works, delayed retreat, hidden-state diagnostics, and self-directed obstruction without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: صَدُّوا can retain both turning themselves away and barring others; neither valency should erase the other.
The terminal noun may describe an overt continuous identity, a latent identity finally exposed, or both.
The causal link from route-blocking to work-loss and then to non-forgiveness is abductive; the packet also permits parallel consequences without one generating the next.
Patronage, habitat, circulation, and agricultural growth are layered mechanisms, not replacements for the verse's juridical and theological surface.
The M-W-T yielding branch is only counterfactual wordplay because the focus form itself denotes physical death.
